definition: qesR study code.
Year of the study (for qes_crop_2007_2010, the year of each monthly poll).
English name of the study, from the qesR catalog.
note: The Durand panels, the CROP polls and the 1998 polls carry their own titles since qesR 0.5.0.

definition: Respondent identifier from the study's file, or <study>_<row> where the file has none (qes2014, qes2018_panel).
note: qes2007_panel repeats `quest` across its two subsamples: use the row order, not respondent_id, to tell those respondents apart.

definition: Interview start date-time, as text (qes2022 and qes2014 only).
Interview end date-time, as text (qes2022 only).
Date-time the answers were recorded, as text (qes2022 only).
Mother tongue (French, English, Other); every qes1998 respondent is French, the study's sample restriction.
note: Blanked where the source is the interview or interface language (OD8).

definition: Citizenship (qes2022 only).
Year of birth.
Age in years, from the age item or computed from the year of birth.
Age group: six bands (18-24 ... 65+) where age is known, else the study's own bands.
note: The Durand panels only have three bands (18-34, 35-54, 55+), kept as in 0.4.4 (OD15).

definition: Gender (Man, Woman; qes2022 also Non-binary and Other).
Province: Quebec for every respondent of a Quebec study; qes2022 from its province item.
note: Regional information is in the study files (get_qes()).

definition: Highest level of education in four groups; diploma-based where the study asks for a diploma, years of schooling otherwise.
note: A few labels the 0.4.4 coding did not recognise are left as they are (for example maîtrise in qes2007 and qes2008).

definition: Household income, in each study's own brackets or amounts (not comparable across studies).
Religion, in each study's own categories.
note: Respondents with no religion are missing where the religion item was asked only of those who have one.

definition: Born in Canada (Yes, No).
Interest in politics on 0-10: 4-point items coded 10, 7, 3, 0 from most to least interested, 0-10 items as answered.
note: Mixes 4-point and 0-10 instruments, and general and campaign interest (OD7); the 2018 column is filled in 0.7.0.

definition: Left-right self-placement, 0 (left) to 10 (right).
Reported turnout in the provincial election (1 voted, 0 did not).
note: Only reported turnout: campaign-period likelihood (qes2022) is blanked (OD4).

definition: Party the respondent reported voting for.
note: Only the reported vote: vote intentions (qes2022, qes_crop_2007_2010, qes1998) are blanked (OD4); see vote_choice_timing. The 0.4.4 category Don't know / Refused is kept on purpose until 0.7.0.

definition: Typed answer for another party on the reported-vote question.
No valid source in any study: every value is NA.
No valid source in any study: every value is NA.
Would vote Yes (1) or No (0) in a referendum on Quebec becoming an independent country.
note: Only that question: other wordings (1995 partnership, sovereign country, favour scales, push questions) are blanked (OD5); see sovereignty_item.

definition: Same as sovereignty_support.
Federal party identification (qes2022 only).
Provincial party identification (qes2022 only).
Each study's own survey weight, on its own scale, as in qesR 0.4.4 (OD6).
note: Not normalized: study means range from 1 to about 6. Do not pool weighted estimates across studies without rescaling.

definition: What vote_choice holds in each study: post (the vote reported after the election) or NA (no valid source).
Which question sovereignty_support holds in each study: sov_indep (referendum on an independent country) or NA (no valid source).
